description: For one model, returns its identity (repo, revision, licenseId) and, only for files that are hosted and individually hashed, one row each with path, sha256, sizeBytes and downloadUrl, plus a `shasum -a 256 -c` verify block; a GGUF quant such as Q4_K_M is part of the file name (path). Runtime-family entries (llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, transformers, MLX) are format hints with download and verify lines, not tested run instructions. When commandsAvailable is false (reason no-tested-run-plan), use your own local runner such as llama.cpp, Ollama or LM Studio; a matching hash proves the bytes arrived unchanged, not that the file runs. Returns available:false with no commands when a model has no reviewed hosted files. Wraps GET /api/agents/deployment-plan?artifact=. Arg: artifact (id or resolvable reference).
name: deployment_plan
